annotation.title_clean: 关于开展基层医疗卫生机构医疗质量改善三年行动(2026—2028年)的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Launching the Three-Year Action to Improve Medical Quality in Primary Healthcare Institutions (2026–2028)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国家卫生健康委办公厅; 国家中医药局综合司
annotation.summary_en: Chinese national notice launching a three-year (2026–2028) medical quality improvement campaign in primary healthcare institutions, setting goals, responsibilities, tasks across outpatient, emergency, drug use, lab, nursing, infection control and surgery, and a timeline. AI is mentioned only in passing as support for quality management.
key_provisions_or_claims: Primary care institutions must establish medical quality management systems by 2026–2028 in phases.
Lead hospitals of county medical communities bear overall responsibility; institution heads are first responsible persons.
Annual cycle of self-inspection, improvement, and evaluation by health authorities.
Tasks cover outpatient, emergency, rational drug use, testing, nursing, infection control, surgery.
Encourages AI empowerment and informatization for quality control.
